milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task — the player must navigate to the flower garden and look at the allium. Target is the allium at (4,0,4), with max_distance=3 to prevent false-positive at spawn (spawn-to-target distance is ~5.66 blocks, safely outside the 3-block radius). Facing tolerance of 45° ensures the player is actually looking at the flower.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task — the player must navigate to the fenced animal pen and look at the llama. Target is the llama at (-5,0,-4), with max_distance=6 to account for the fence preventing direct approach. Spawn-to-target distance is ~6.4 blocks, safely outside the 6-block radius at spawn. Facing tolerance of 45° ensures the player is looking toward the pen.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted item (yellow_wool) ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 yellow_wool but has white_wool (4) and yellow_dye (4) pre-given. Gaining at least 1 yellow_wool confirms successful crafting at the crafting table.

Uses inventory_has because a successful villager trade gives the player an emerald. The player starts with 0 emeralds and 64 potatoes. The farmer villager's trade is 26 potatoes → 1 emerald. Gaining at least 1 emerald confirms a successful trade interaction.
